Four CRPF personnel injured in Chhattisgarh landmine blast

Four Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel were injured in a landmine blast in Sukma, Chhattisgarh. Two of the injured personnel are reported to be in critical condition. The injured personnel have been moved to Hyderabad for further treatment.
